title: Senior Fullstack Engineer em natal (RN)
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Fullstack Engineer to join our engineering team and help build and scale a modern commercial software platform.

You’ll be working with Node.js and AWS, developing and integrating solutions across originations, payments, fraud, and financial infrastructure.

A key part of the role is using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar platforms to build, improve, test, and ship production software efficiently.

We’re looking for an engineer who is comfortable working with AI as part of their everyday development workflow while maintaining high standards for code quality, security, testing, reliability, and scalability.

Responsibilities and assignments

Design, develop, and maintain production-grade Node.js applications and services.

Use AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Cursor as core development tools, not simply as occasional assistants.

Translate product and business requirements into robust technical solutions.

Use AI to accelerate development, refactoring, debugging, testing, documentation, and code generation while maintaining ownership of the resulting code.

Build and integrate APIs with third-party commercial software.

Develop integrations across payments, fraud, originations, and financial infrastructure.

Work with AWS services to deploy, operate, and scale applications.

Review and improve AI-generated code for security, performance, reliability, and maintainability.

Refactor legacy or externally developed systems into clean, maintainable Node.js services.

Write automated tests and ensure appropriate engineering quality gates.

Troubleshoot production issues and contribute to observability and operational improvements.

Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders.

Make pragmatic architectural decisions in a fast-moving environment.

Requirements and qualifications

  • Strong API and backend development experience
  • Experience building and integrating REST APIs and other service interfaces
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and engineering principles
  • Experience working with AWS
  • Experience with databases and data modelling
  • Experience with automated testing and CI/CD
  • Experience integrating third-party SaaS and API platforms
  • Strong knowledge of Git and modern software development practices
  • Experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar
  • FinTech or financial services experience is preferred
  • Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a fast-moving engineering environment
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a practical, hands-on approach to development

Additional information

Our client is a well-established UK-based digital retail and financial services organisation with a strong focus on technology, customer experience, and innovation.

The business operates across retail, payments, credit, fraud, and financial services, with a growing investment in modern cloud technology and AI-driven software development.

This is an opportunity to join a business undergoing technology transformation, working with modern platforms, APIs, AWS, Node.js , and AI development tools such as Claude Code and Cursor.

description:
Job description


Como Site Manager, você será responsável pela gestão da implantação de projetos de geração de energia renovável, principalmente nos segmentos eólico e solar, desde o planejamento até a entrega final.


Atuará na liderança das operações em campo e na integração entre Engenharia, Suprimentos, Meio Ambiente, ESG, Fundiário, fornecedores, equipes de obra, PMO, O&M e demais stakeholders, garantindo segurança, qualidade, prazo, custos e sustentabilidade.


Será uma posição estratégica para a coordenação das frentes de implantação, gestão de riscos e resolução de desafios em campo, contribuindo diretamente para a excelência técnica e operacional dos projetos da Casa dos Ventos.



Main responsibilities



  • Planejar, coordenar e acompanhar a execução física dos projetos de energia renovável, assegurando o cumprimento de cronogramas, orçamento, recursos e marcos contratuais.

  • Liderar as equipes de campo e contratadas, promovendo alinhamento técnico-operacional, comunicação eficiente e foco na entrega dos objetivos do projeto.

  • Gerenciar contratos, fornecedores e empreiteiras, garantindo escopo, prazo, qualidade e condições contratuais, incluindo negociações, aditivos e validação das medições.

  • Monitorar riscos e desvios da implantação, definindo ações corretivas e planos de contingência para garantir a continuidade operacional e a integridade física, ambiental e financeira do projeto.

  • Assegurar os padrões de Saúde, Segurança, Meio Ambiente e ESG, garantindo conformidade com legislações, licenças e procedimentos internos, em conjunto com as áreas de HSE e Meio Ambiente.

  • Acompanhar e reportar o desempenho do projeto, elaborando relatórios de progresso, conduzindo reuniões de obra e apresentando resultados à liderança e aos principais stakeholders.

  • Coordenar as etapas de energização e comissionamento, integrando Engenharia, O&M, Conexão, Operador do Sistema e demais áreas envolvidas na entrada em operação dos ativos.

  • Promover melhoria contínua na implantação, atuando na gestão de conflitos, padronização de processos e métodos construtivos, adoção de novas tecnologias e registro de lições aprendidas.



Requirements and skills



  • Formação superior em Engenharia Civil, Elétrica, Produção ou áreas correlatas.

  • Experiência consolidada em gestão de obras de grande porte, preferencialmente em projetos de energia renovável ou infraestrutura.

  • Conhecimento em metodologias de gestão de projetos, como PMBOK, Lean Construction, Scrum ou similares.

  • Domínio de ferramentas de planejamento e controle, como MS Project, Primavera P6, Excel avançado e Power BI.

  • Experiência em gestão de equipes, empreiteiras, subempreiteiros e fornecedores, com forte atuação em campo.



Additional information


- Liderança e capacidade de influência.


- Comunicação clara e objetiva.


- Visão sistêmica e pensamento estratégico.


- Proatividade e orientação para resultados.


- Resiliência e capacidade de tomada decisão sob pressão.


- Foco em segurança, qualidade e sustentabilidade.

Regional Linehaul Operations Manager , ATS - Middle Mile

Amazon Transportation Services is looking for a Regional Operations Linehaul Manager to join our ATS Middle Mile Ground Brazil team. This is a senior, high-complexity position that requires experienced leadership to manage middle mile linehaul operations across Southeast region.

In this role, you will lead and optimize linehaul operations at a regional level, ensuring operational excellence across the full middle mile transportation process. Unlike a single-carrier or station-focused role, this position is cross-functional and regional - you will work across all carriers and programs in your region, acting as the bridge between central strategy and local execution.

You will be part of a highly collaborative, dynamic, and innovative environment where ideas are valued and experimentation is encouraged. We are looking for professionals with a strong track record of operational excellence and customer focus, who thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments and are ready to lead through complexity and constant change.

If you enjoy challenges and are ready to deliver results in an environment that combines the energy of a start-up with the scale of a global company, we want to meet you.

Key job responsibilities

Regional Operations & Performance Management

  • Lead regional linehaul operations cross-functionally across all carriers and programs in the region
  • Manage performance of multiple carriers, ensuring achievement of OTP (On-Time Pickup) and OTA (On-Time Arrival) targets
  • Conduct daily and weekly operational reviews, leading calls with operational teams and developing action plans for continuous improvement
  • Perform Gemba walks and on-road monitoring to identify process gaps and implement corrective actions
  • Communicate daily metrics and report exceptions to other operational departments

Carrier Management & Development

  • Coordinate onboarding, training and ramp-up of new carriers in the region, including supporting on-site audits
  • Implement and scale the Amazon Excellence Program with regional carriers
  • Develop strategic relationships with carriers, serving as primary point of contact for performance and problem resolution regionally/locally

Operational Excellence & Cost Management

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean and Kaizen methodologies
  • Identify optimization opportunities and implement solutions to improve operational efficiency
  • Contribute to cost reduction initiatives through identification of regional optimization opportunities
  • Support regional implementation of network optimization and routing efficiency initiatives

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Collaborate with central and represent regional operations in business reviews, act as bridge between central strategy and regional execution
  • Serve as voice of carriers within regional operations

Basic Qualifications

  • - Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • - Work a flexible work schedule including evenings, overnights, and weekends
  • - Experience in managing teams
  • - Experience in a logistics/operations environment
  • - Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above

Preferred Qualifications

  • - Experience with performance metrics and process improvement and Lean techniques

Buscamos uma pessoa com visão comercial, capacidade de influência, construção de relacionamento e senso de dono . Alguém que tenha facilidade para abrir portas, criar conexões e transformar uma rede de relacionamentos em um canal consistente e escalável de geração de negócios .

Formação superior completa em Direito e inscrição ativa na OAB.

Experiência prévia consolidada em Direito Societário e operações de M&A em empresas de grande porte ou escritórios de advocacia (tier 1/2).

Domínio em redação técnica, elaboração e negociação de contratos complexos.

Forte visão de negócios, visão estratégica de riscos e excelente capacidade analítica.

Responsável pela coordenação, controle de equipes e operações de armazenagem nos silos (grande volume de recebimento e armazenagem ou complexidade da operação), acompanhando o fluxo de entrada de matéria prima e abastecimento da produção, garantindo a qualidade e padronização de produtos recebidos, armazenados e expedidos, visando o atingimento das metas do plano de produção dentro dos padrões de segurança, qualidade, produtividade, segurança de alimentos e proteção do meio ambiente.

Atividades e Responsabilidades:

  • Controlar e realizar a gestão para que o planejamento e a programação atinjam os requisitos das demandas, mediante a supervisão das atividades produtivas, solução de problemas, otimização de recursos e interface com as demais áreas do negócio.
  • Realizar a gestão das atividades de recebimento, armazenagem e expedição, assegurando o atendimento dos procedimentos para cada etapa para que o produto esteja no padrão especificado.
  • Orientar, acompanhar e, se necessário, redirecionar as demandas de trabalho da equipe, de acordo as necessidades técnicas e operacionais da área, buscando atingir os objetivos e metas pré-estabelecidas.
  • Atuar na solução de problemas que possam surgir durante a operação e manter todos os envolvidos informados consultando seu Gestor sempre que necessário na tomada de decisão.
  • Assegurar a motivação da equipe e o nível adequado de qualificação e desempenho, através da identificação de necessidade de treinamento / desenvolvimento profissional de seus subordinados participando da elaboração do programa de treinamento com a área de Gente e Gestão.
  • Autorizar as PTP (Permissão Trabalhos Perigosos - documentos de segurança para liberação de atividades críticas / perigosas das equipes), verificando e validando a necessidade e encaminhando para a realização dos trabalhos.
  • Assegurar a adequada operação e limpeza das áreas, mediante o cumprimento das normas estabelecidas.
  • Assegurar a integridade física e segurança dos funcionários, máquinas e equipamentos, através da observação, cumprimento e difusão das normas e procedimentos de segurança no trabalho.
  • Identificar e colaborar com a implantação das ações de melhorias levantadas para os processos da unidade.
  • Atender e responder as auditorias internas e externas realizadas na unidade.
  • Participar de projetos estruturais para melhoria da produtividade, otimização de processos e outros da área, indicando investimentos.
  • Realizar a gestão das manutenções preditivas e preventivas da área, verificando a máxima continuidade das operações, priorizando máquinas, equipamentos e planejamento dos recursos necessários.
  • Realizar a gestão de controle de estoque, acompanhando e validando relatório de controle de estoque (conciliação) e inventários periódicos.
  • Controlar o Orçamento Matricial, acompanhando os lançamentos, solicitando as reclassificações e corrigindo lançamentos entre contas.
  • Promover melhorias nas rotinas de trabalho, analisando os processos internos, comparando com empresas do mesmo segmento, criando, desenvolvendo e analisando instruções e opções, visando a otimização e desempenho da equipe.
  • Garantir e apoiar o cumprimento das Boas Práticas de Fabricação, Transporte e Armazenagem, 5’s, procedimentos operacionais e do sistema de gestão, disseminar a cultura e a política de qualidade e segurança dos alimentos, verificar os monitoramentos com impacto em qualidade e segurança dos alimentos e assegurar a tomada de ação imediata e corretiva para os desvios observados.

  • Conhecer, apoiar e disseminar os KPI’s de qualidade e segurança de alimentos.
  • Promover o uso de informações provenientes de medidores de parâmetros de qualidade online, e para os pontos de inspeções onde não há essa disponibilidade, incentivar que a coleta de amostras, para as análises realizadas em laboratório, seja representativa, permitindo que os resultados obtidos auxiliem no controle e melhoria dos processos e qualidade dos produtos.

title: GTM Engineer (Go-to-market) | Regulated DTC Consumer Brand em paraná (RN)
description:
Company Overview:

Our client is a small, founder‑led consumer brand based in Austin, TX, that makes a regulated nicotine product (tobacco‑free pouches) and sells it direct‑to‑consumer in the UK. Because Meta, Google, and TikTok all prohibit nicotine advertising, there is no ad budget this company can spend to buy growth — every channel that’s left (search, owned email and SMS, subscription retention, referral, retail and trade, athlete and podcast partnerships, field sampling) has to be built and wired together by hand. That constraint is the whole shape of this job.

Your Role:

This role exists because the easy version of growth marketing isn’t available here — someone has to build the campaign machinery, not just brief it. You’ll spend real time each week directing Claude Code to connect APIs, enrich lists, and automate recurring work, and the rest of your time running campaigns alongside the people actually knocking on doors: sales, field, and partnerships. You report directly to the two founders, at manager level, fully hands‑on, with no reports of your own (headcount comes later, if at all). Success looks like a trade and partnership outbound engine that runs itself, a field team that’s armed and getting better each cycle, owned channels (search, lifecycle, retention, referral) doing the growth work that paid acquisition can’t, and numbers everyone can actually trust.

A note on the category: this is a regulated product, and the rules aren’t style guidance — they’re hard constraints on the job itself. No health, cessation, or performance claims anywhere, ever. Age and territory gating (18+, UK only) stays intact, full stop. No paid social or paid search for the product, no workarounds. Nothing overstated in writing. If that reads as a limitation on the work rather than the actual shape of it, this isn’t the right seat.

You’ll:

Build and run the trade and partnership outbound engine — define the segment, pull and enrich the list, verify and score contacts, write and track the sequence, and know when not to use a sequencer (some outreach has to go out by hand)

Arm the field team (sampling, shop visits, trade shows) with target lists, routes, one‑pagers, and post‑visit follow‑up sequences, then work alongside them so the next version is better

Own the channels that are actually open here: search and content, lifecycle email and SMS, subscription retention (win‑back, dunning recovery, pause‑instead‑of‑cancel), and referral programs, including the reconciliation behind them

Produce creative in‑house with AI tools against the brand’s existing visual system — knowing when to generate, when to composite a real product shot instead, and when to send a piece to a human

Automate anything manual and recurring — enrichment scripts, list hygiene, report pulls, campaign QA, content pipelines — instead of adding it to someone’s checklist

Own first‑party measurement (order and subscription data, cohort retention, referral attribution, search visibility), since no ad platform is feeding this business conversion data, and flag a bad number before anyone else finds it

You Bring:

Real, hands‑on experience directing Claude Code (or an equivalent coding agent) on live work — connected to an API or MCP server, shipping something still in use today. This is the one non‑negotiable requirement on this list, and it’s tested directly in the interview process; nearly everything else here is trainable

3+ years hands‑on in marketing — the profile that fits typically started in a coordinator‑type role, got tired of waiting on others to pull data or wire up tools, and taught themselves to do it

Cold outbound you’ve run yourself, start to finish: built the list, wrote the sequence, watched the reply rate, fixed deliverability when it broke, using Apollo or an equivalent plus at least one sequencer

Comfortable with data — you read a CSV without flinching, write SQL or get there with help, and know why a bad join can quietly double your numbers

Working scripting ability in Python or JavaScript (or a track record of directing AI to write and debug it while keeping it honest), and you use git

APIs are ordinary to you: auth, keys, rate limits, webhooks, and reading docs to find the endpoint you need

A genuine eye for marketing — you can tell a good offer from a weak one, spot a broken page, and write an email a retail buyer will actually answer — and you write plainly, in specific, filler‑free sentences

Bonus Points:

Experience with this kind of stack: list/enrichment tools (e.g. Apollo), sequencers, a commerce/subscription backend, Postgres/SQL, transactional email, SEO tooling, workflow automation (e.g. n8n), and AI image tools

Background marketing in a regulated or high‑constraint category (alcohol, supplements, pharma, gambling, or similar), where claims review and compliance shape every campaign

DTC subscription or ecommerce experience, especially retention/win‑back programs and referral mechanics

What’s Offered:

Based in Austin, TX, or remote with 9–5 CT overlap

Direct reporting line to the two founders — high visibility, real ownership, minimal layers

A hands‑on, builder‑first seat: you ship the work yourself rather than briefing someone else to

Real autonomy over a growth stack built on search, lifecycle, retention, referral, trade, and field — not ad spend

The chance to help build out the company’s own agent and automation stack from the ground up

Compensation based on experience and location — to confirm with the client before this goes to candidates

Interview Process:

  1. Apply with a short note naming one thing you’ve built with Claude Code and what it does today (link it if you can)
  2. Screening call (30 minutes) — walking through that build in detail
  3. Paid exercise (about 3 hours) — given a target segment and API access, produce a scored, enriched contact list, a three-touch sequence, and the script or flow that generated it; one touch has to survive a claims review
  4. Working session with a founder — pick the exercise apart together and build one more thing live in Claude Code
